title: OpsDesk AI
subtitle: Ask about tasks, reports and coverage
greeting: Hi Lilianna, I can summarise today's work, spot risks and draft reminders. What do you need?
suggestions: Draft a reminder to the Cleaning lead

replies.text: There are 7 overdue tasks, 3 of them blocked. The most urgent is "Chase delivery of floor cleaner" (TSK-1031, Tomasz Wójcik), blocked since yesterday. Two others are late today: Riverside House deep-clean photos and the Shoreditch incident report.
Draft: "Hi Grace, the Cleaning daily report is still in draft (7 of 10 sections). Please complete and submit it before 5:30 PM London time. Thanks, Lilianna." Want me to send it?
3 documents expire in the next 45 days: SIA licence for M. Haddad (12 days), Right to work for J. Silva (25 days) and DBS check for A. Kowalski (43 days). The SIA renewal has not started yet.
2 shifts are uncovered tomorrow: Canary Wharf 22:00 and Shoreditch 06:00. Next week has 5 gaps, mostly weekend cleaning rounds. 3 call-outs were covered today.

fallback: This is a demo assistant with sample answers. Try asking about overdue tasks, reminders, expiring documents or shift coverage.
